notes: CDER letter following an on-site inspection of an OTC contract manufacturer, citing inadequate component identity/COA-reliability testing, unvalidated non-compendial microbiological release testing, failure to investigate out-of-limit water-system microbial results (product released despite OOL results), and an ineffective quality unit, plus a separate drug-listing/misbranding violation for failing to list 'KleenLine Alcohol-Free Sanitizing Wipes' under the private-label distributor's labeler code. The API and most components are redacted as (b)(4), but the two named consumer products (KleenLine Alcohol-Free Sanitizing Wipes; Hand Sanitizing Alcohol-Free Wipes) are stated in clear text, so product_redacted is false. No genus/species organism is identified.
